content.title: Unbroken Dribble | Foreground Sport Task and Background Launch
content.summary: An original aerospace coach keeps dribbling while a launch vehicle rises behind him. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original lead remains calm and identifiable. + A small foreground ritual never loses continuity. + Background disorder escalates in readable stages. + Any physical conflict is non-graphic and choreographed. + The ending returns attention to the lead's completed ritual.
quick_start.recommended_input: One original clearly adult aerospace coach begins a steady basketball dribble along a marked service lane. Ignition light appears and white vapor expands while the coach keeps the same hand-switch rhythm. Pull wide to hold the adult coach, bouncing ball, launch trail and service lane in one readable composition.
